f.title: Fine for legal persons not reporting adverse reactions in writing to HALMED (and HZJZ for vaccines) (Art. 145)
f.statement: New Article 229 of the Medicinal Products Act (replaced by Art. 9 of this amending Act) fines a legal person EUR 3,980.00 to 6,630.00 if it does not notify the Agency (HALMED) in writing, and for vaccines also the Croatian Institute of Public Health, of adverse reactions of a medicinal product in accordance with the Act and its implementing regulations (Article 145(1)-(3)); the responsible person in the legal person and a natural person are fined EUR 390.00 to 660.00.
